source:
@@U00138@@
You'll forgive me, but it’s a great delight to enter into the spirit of times past; to know what wise men before us thought, and then measure how far we've come in the meanwhile.

@@U00140@@
As far as the stars! Yes! Times past, my friend, are a book with seven seals. And what you call the spirit of the times is nothing more than the spirit of you gentlemen in which the past is reflected. And a sad affair that reflection is, too! One glance and you run for your lives. A trash barrel! A junk room! At best, a blood-and-thunder play with excellent pragmatical maxims suitable for the mouths of puppets.

@@U00142@@
But what of the world? What of the hearts and minds of men? Surely we all want knowledge of such things.

@@U00144@@
Knowledge! Yes, what’s known as “knowledge.” That’s what you mean, isn’t it? But who'll call the child by its right name? Who would dare? The few who really knew—the few who were foolish enough not to keep it to themselves, who spilled their full hearts to the rabble, their feelings, their visions, have from the beginning of time been crucified and burned at the stake. But you must excuse me, my friend. It’s very late; we really must stop for now.
translation:
@@U00138@@
你会原谅我的，但能够体会到过去时代的精神是一件非常令人高兴的事。了解我们之前的智者的想法，然后衡量我们在此期间已经走了多远。

@@U00140@@
至星星为止！是的！我的朋友，过去的时光是一本有七个封印的书。而你们所说的时代精神，无非是诸位先生的精神，反映了过去。这种反思也是一件令人悲伤的事情！一看，你就逃命了。一个垃圾桶！一个垃圾房！充其量只是一部血与雷的戏剧，有着适合木偶口中的优秀务实格言。

@@U00142@@
但世界又如何呢？男人的心灵和思想又如何呢？当然，我们都想了解这些事情。

@@U00144@@
知识！是的，就是所谓的“知识”。这就是你的意思，不是吗？但谁会用正确的名字来称呼孩子呢？谁敢？少数真正知道真相的人——少数愚蠢到不把这件事保密的人，他们向乌合之众倾诉了自己的全部心声、他们的感情、他们的愿景，从一开始就被钉在十字架上并烧死在火刑柱上。但你必须原谅我，我的朋友。已经很晚了；我们现在确实必须停下来。
